wins.text: Q4 AI revenue grew 150% YoY to $3.7B; full-year AI revenue grew 220% YoY from $3.8B to $12.2B, representing 41% of semiconductor revenue
Consolidated Q4 revenue of $14.1B up 51% YoY; full-year revenue hit record $51.6B, up 44% YoY

VMware integration largely complete with operating margin reaching 70% exiting 2024, up from sub-30% pre-acquisition; on track to exceed $8.5B incremental adjusted EBITDA target ahead of 3-year schedule
Infrastructure software operating margin reached 72% in Q4 (73% ex-transition costs); ABV grew to $2.7B in Q4 from $2.5B in Q3, with over 4,500 of largest 10,000 customers signed up for VCF
Returned record $22.2B in cash to shareholders in FY2024 (up 45% YoY); announced 11% dividend increase to $0.59/share quarterly, the 14th consecutive annual dividend increase since 2011

risks.text: Semiconductor gross margins compressed ~220 bps YoY to ~67% due to higher mix of lower-margin AI XPUs; management acknowledged gross margin dilution will continue as AI scales
Non-AI semiconductor revenue declined 23% YoY to $4.5B in Q4; industrial down 27% YoY with recovery not expected until H2 2025; broadband down 51% YoY
Free cash flow as % of revenue declined YoY due to higher cash interest expense from VMware acquisition debt ($69.8B gross principal), higher cash taxes, and delayed reenactment of Section 174
AI revenue growth is concentrated in only 3 hyperscale customers, with quarter-to-quarter variability expected as deployments come in large, lumpy chunks
Two additional hyperscale XPU customers are still in advanced development/tape-out phase with no confirmed revenue ramp timeline before 2027; software and testing readiness remain gating factors

guidance_items.detail: Q1 FY2025 consolidated revenue guided to ~$14.6B, up 22% YoY; semiconductor revenue ~$8.1B (+10% YoY); infrastructure software ~$6.5B (+41% YoY)
Q1 adjusted EBITDA guided to record ~66% of revenue, up from 65% in Q4; consolidated gross margins expected up ~100 bps sequentially
Q1 AI revenue expected to grow 65% YoY to ~$3.8B; infrastructure software ABV expected to exceed $3B vs. $2.7B in Q4
Non-GAAP tax rate for FY2025 expected at ~14.5%; Q1 non-GAAP diluted share count ~4.9B shares; quarterly dividend raised to $0.59/share (11% increase)

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Competitive dynamics between Broadcom XPUs and NVIDIA rack-scale merchant silicon products
Implied market share assumptions within the $60B-$90B SAM and what portion Broadcom will not capture
M&A appetite and strategic priorities now that VMware integration is largely complete
